preconditions.description: The integer k must be between 1 and the length of the string s.
The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The input s must be a string.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string must be less than or equal to the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] != s[i+1] or s[i] != s[i+k-1] for i in range(len(stdout) - k + 1))
postconditions.description: The output string must not contain any group of k consecutive identical characters.
The output string must be the result of reducing the input string s by removing groups of k consecutive identical characters.
